methodology.description: Bounded adjustments for confirmed coaching transitions and objectively material veteran trades. Draft picks and ordinary free-agent movement are excluded.
rules: A proven head coach with at least 10 seasons and a career winning percentage above .575 is worth 8 rating points when added or lost.
A coordinator or play-caller with a multi-season top-10 unit track record is worth up to 6 unit-specific rating points.
A first-time head-coach transition carries 3 points of implementation uncertainty.
A reigning AP Player of the Year at a premium position is worth 18 points; recent first-team All-Pro premium players are worth 12; established premium starters are worth 6.
Trades are scored net of the material player sent away, and total coaching and personnel effects are capped separately.

coaching.label: Jesse Minter / Anthony Weaver defensive leadership
coaching.reason: Minter brings a demonstrated defensive track record and Weaver returns as coordinator.

coaching.label: First-year head-coach implementation
coaching.reason: Minter is installing his first program as an NFL head coach.

coaching.label: John Harbaugh head-coach track record
coaching.reason: Harbaugh arrives with 18 seasons, a .614 regular-season winning percentage and a Super Bowl title.

coaching.label: Established coordinator staff
coaching.reason: Matt Nagy, Dennard Wilson and Chris Horton bring prior coordinator experience across all three units.

coaching.label: Mike Tomlin departure
coaching.reason: Pittsburgh loses a head coach with 19 seasons of organizational continuity and no losing regular season.

coaching.label: Mike McDaniel offensive play-calling
coaching.reason: McDaniel replaces Greg Roman after directing a multi-season top-10 Miami offense.

coaching.label: Defensive coordinator continuity
coaching.reason: Chris O'Leary replaces Minter but previously coached in the same Chargers defensive system.

personnel.label: Myles Garrett for Jared Verse
personnel.reason: The reigning Defensive Player of the Year replaces an established premium edge starter, so only the net upgrade is credited.

personnel.label: Trent McDuffie acquisition
personnel.reason: A recent first-team All-Pro cornerback is added to a premium coverage role.

personnel.label: Trent McDuffie departure
personnel.reason: Kansas City loses a recent first-team All-Pro cornerback from a premium coverage role.

personnel.label: Myles Garrett for Jared Verse
personnel.reason: Cleveland receives an established edge starter but loses the reigning Defensive Player of the Year.
